review_notes: Read the whole file, the Mathlib maximalRealSubfield definitions, and the downstream uses of the two simp lemmas (FixedField.lean, GenusField.lean). I did not run Lean, so I claim no observed simp behaviour. Both findings rest on reading the lemma statements and their uses. The other @[simp] lemma (coe_candidateGenusFieldRealBaseRoot, an rfl lemma) looks fine.

findings.problem: The membership characterization is tagged @[simp]. Its right side is a universally quantified statement over all complex embeddings of the compositum. Any simp call on a goal containing `x ∈ candidateGenusFieldReal hd` will therefore expand it into `∀ φ, star (φ x) = φ x`. That form is less useful than the structural characterization of the same membership, `candidateGenusFieldConj hd x = x`, proved as `candidateGenusFieldConj_apply_eq_self_iff`. It also hides the intermediate-field structure, because membership lemmas such as closure under algebraMap would no longer fire on the original form. The only downstream use is an explicit `rw [mem_candidateGenusFieldReal_iff]`, so the simp attribute is not needed there. Mathlib's analogous `mem_maximalRealSubfield_iff` is not simp.
findings.proposed_change: Remove `@[simp]` from `mem_candidateGenusFieldReal_iff` and keep it as a plain `rw`/`simp only` characterization, as the existing `rw` use in FixedField.lean already does. Make `candidateGenusFieldConj_apply_eq_self_iff` the simp-facing normal form only if it is wanted.
findings.benefit: Membership goals stay in the compact `x ∈ candidateGenusFieldReal hd` form. Downstream simp calls do not unexpectedly unfold into a quantifier over embeddings. Users opt into the embedding characterization explicitly.

findings.problem: This simp lemma's right side is not in simp normal form. `algebraMap ℚ R ((d : ℤ) : ℚ)` is a ring-hom image of an integer cast. The standard simp lemmas `map_intCast` and `eq_intCast` should reduce it further to `(d : R)`. The simp set therefore needs a second rewrite after this lemma fires, and the lemma and its normal form disagree. Uses of the lemma (`rw [candidateGenusFieldRealBaseRoot_sq, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℤ ℚ]` in GenusField.lean) then have to rewrite in the opposite direction by hand to reach the integer cast. I did not run Lean, so this follows from the lemma statements.
findings.proposed_change: State the simp lemma as `candidateGenusFieldRealBaseRoot hd hpos ^ 2 = (d : candidateGenusFieldReal hd)`, deriving it from the current statement with `map_intCast`. Keep the `algebraMap ℚ _ (d : ℚ)` version as a separate non-simp lemma for the `rw` uses.
findings.benefit: A single simp rewrite yields the canonical integer-cast form. Goals such as `y ^ 2 = d` close without manual `IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply` steps. The simp lemma and the simp normal form no longer disagree.
